content.user_title: Manage pnpm Projects With Reliable Guidance
content.value_statement: pnpm projects need precise commands, strict dependency handling, and safe configuration choices. This skill provides focused guidance for installs, workspaces, CI, patches, and migration tasks.
actual_capabilities: Explains pnpm commands for install, add, remove, update, run, exec, and dlx workflows.
Guides workspace setup with pnpm-workspace.yaml, shared lockfiles, filters, and workspace protocols.
Helps configure .npmrc and pnpm settings for peer dependencies, hoisting, registries, and store behavior.
Provides CI guidance for frozen lockfiles, Corepack, store caching, and matrix builds.
Covers advanced dependency control through catalogs, overrides, package extensions, patches, aliases, and hooks.
Supports migration planning from npm or Yarn while preserving dependency intent and lockfile discipline.
limitations: It provides guidance only; it does not execute pnpm commands by itself.
It assumes pnpm 10.x behavior and may need review for newer releases.
It cannot verify private registry credentials or package availability without project access.
It should not expose token values from .npmrc, environment variables, or CI settings.

use_cases.title: Set Up a Monorepo
use_cases.description: Plan workspace packages, shared dependency versions, filters, and lockfile behavior for a multi-package repository.

use_cases.title: Improve CI Installs
use_cases.description: Choose frozen lockfile settings, Corepack setup, cache keys, and store paths for faster reliable builds.

use_cases.title: Resolve Dependency Problems
use_cases.description: Diagnose peer dependency warnings, phantom dependency failures, overrides, patches, and migration issues.

prompt_templates.title: Understand My Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my pnpm project layout. Explain the workspace structure, important configuration files, and safe next steps before changing dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Dependency Resolution
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me diagnose this pnpm dependency or peer dependency issue. Explain likely causes, configuration options, and the safest fix.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize CI Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a pnpm CI install strategy for this repository. Cover Corepack, frozen lockfiles, caching, workspace filters, and failure modes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Package Manager Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pnpm migration plan from npm or Yarn. Include dependency cleanup, workspace conversion, lockfile changes, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Why does pnpm fail when npm installed this package tree successfully?
output_examples.output: The skill explains phantom dependency behavior, identifies missing direct dependencies, and recommends adding declared dependencies instead of relying on transitive packages.

output_examples.input: How should our repository cache pnpm installs in CI?
output_examples.output: The skill recommends using a stable pnpm version, frozen lockfiles, store caching keyed by the lockfile, and separate validation for changed workspaces.

output_examples.input: We need to patch a dependency until an upstream fix is released.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines the patch workflow, reminds you to document the reason, and suggests revisiting the patch when the dependency is upgraded.

best_practices: Use frozen lockfiles in CI so dependency resolution stays reproducible.
Prefer pnpm-workspace.yaml for pnpm-specific workspace settings when possible.
Document overrides, package extensions, and patches so future upgrades remain clear.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on phantom dependencies that are only present through transitive packages.
Do not paste registry tokens or private .npmrc values into prompts or logs.
Do not use broad overrides or patches without a clear version scope and removal plan.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps AI coding tools reason about pnpm commands, configuration, workspaces, CI, migration, and dependency maintenance.

faq.question: Does it run pnpm commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance that an AI agent or user can apply within the active project.

faq.question: Can it help with monorepos?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers pnpm workspaces, filters, shared lockfiles, catalogs, and workspace dependency protocols.

faq.question: Can it help migrate from npm or Yarn?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains migration steps, lockfile changes, workspace conversion, and common compatibility issues.

faq.question: How should secrets in .npmrc be handled?
faq.answer: Keep token values private. Share only redacted configuration or environment variable names when asking for help.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
